entries.en: <kiroshi l="creo" o="M...Mwen pap ale la?" t="I... I'm not goin' in there." b="" a=""/>
entries.ro: <kiroshi l="creo" o="M...Mwen pap ale la?" t="Eu... eu nu intru acolo." b="" a=""/>

entries.en: <kiroshi l="creo" o="Ou ap plonje. Koulye a?" t="You are diving in now." b="" a=""/>
entries.ro: <kiroshi l="creo" o="Ou ap plonje. Koulye a?" t="Intri acum." b="" a=""/>

entries.en: <kiroshi l="creo" o="Non non non, ou konnen kisa? Koulye mwen panse 'li te dwe kèk lòt pil fatra. Wi?" t="No no no, know what? Now I'm thinkin' it musta been some other dumpster. Yeah." b="" a=""/>
entries.ro: <kiroshi l="creo" o="Non non non, ou konnen kisa? Koulye mwen panse 'li te dwe kèk lòt pil fatra. Wi?" t="Nu, nu, nu, știi ce? Acu' cred că a fost alt container. Da." b="" a=""/>

entries.en: <kiroshi l="creo" o="Oke. An nou fè sa. Mwen vle bagay yo pa pasè minui?" t="OK. Let's do this. I want the stuff by midnight." b="" a=""/>
entries.ro: <kiroshi l="creo" o="Oke. An nou fè sa. Mwen vle bagay yo pa pasè minui?" t="OK. Hai s-o facem. Vreau marfa până la miezul nopții." b="" a=""/>

entries.en: <kiroshi l="creo" o="Mwen pa bezwen konnen ki jan ou jwenn li. Sa pa gade bounda'm." t="I don't need to know how you get it. That has nothing to do with my ass." b="" a=""/>
entries.ro: <kiroshi l="creo" o="Mwen pa bezwen konnen ki jan ou jwenn li. Sa pa gade bounda'm." t="Nu trebuie să știu cum le iei. Pe mine nu mă doare-n cur." b="" a=""/>
